name: Where the Return Was
description: Day two. Yesterday the picture put a second, fainter mark on the plate, as if the surface had answered. Nothing answered. The instrument is still aimed at the plate. One mark remains. The place of the return is empty. A study this month found that people will grant awareness when something responds, and will withhold the name of consciousness even then. This picture keeps the blank. It does not know if registering a silence is looking.
